1.consolidated_definition: “Venirle con bravatas o habladurías”, según Malaret. “Tanto brinco y tanto lío,/ Mucho anuncio, y total, res.” Cintrón, Bombones de sal ,1910, p. 181 .
1.en_consolidated_definition: To come on with boasts or idle talk, according to Malaret. "So much jumping and so much commotion,/ Much announcement, and in the end, nothing." Cintrón, Bombones de sal ,1910, p. 181 .
